title: Declare each interlocking's entrypoint shape: exposed flag plus actions or reason

facts.note: Validation subject_kind is interlocking. The source does not say how interlocking declarations are found in a plan, so an observer that lists every interlocking declaration in the plan is needed. It must cover unchanged declarations as well as new or edited ones.
The validator runs in CONFIRM and is confirm-blocking. The harness needs a phase observer to know that CONFIRM is active.

fires: CONFIRM evaluates a plan that contains any interlocking declaration, whether or not the current change touched it.
In CONFIRM, an interlocking has no exposed value.
In CONFIRM, an interlocking declares exposed:true with an empty or missing actions list.
In CONFIRM, an interlocking declares exposed:false without a reason.
In CONFIRM, an interlocking's actions list contains train IDs instead of Station Master action names.
doesNotFire: Checking whether the listed Station Master actions actually reach the interlocking at runtime. This check validates shape only.
Any phase other than CONFIRM. This validator runs in CONFIRM.

when: The plan is validated in CONFIRM. Every interlocking in the plan is checked, including unchanged ones.
then: Every interlocking declares whether it is runtime-exposed. exposed:true must list at least one Station Master action name expected to reach it. exposed:false must give a reason.
prefer: Set exposed explicitly on every interlocking.
List actions by their Station Master action names, meaning the actions expected to reach the interlocking.
avoid: exposed:true with an empty or missing actions list.
exposed:false with no reason, or with an empty or placeholder reason that only fills the field.
Putting train IDs in actions instead of Station Master action names.
Treating a passing result from this check as proof of runtime reachability. The planner validates shape only.
why: Each interlocking must state whether it is runtime-exposed and which Station Master actions are expected to reach it. That keeps its entrypoint shape explicit and checkable.
evidence: Every interlocking has exposed set. Each exposed:true interlocking has actions length >= 1, given as Station Master action names. Each exposed:false interlocking has a reason.
On failure, the report names interlocking_id, exposed, actions, reason and field_path.
verifier_detail: Validation family: schema. Template: required_field_presence. Variant: planner_train_interlocking_entrypoint_shape. Subject_kind: interlocking.

Rule (term entrypoint_shape): exposed:true requires actions>=1; exposed:false requires reason; actions are Station Master action names, not train IDs; the planner validates shape only (this check does not verify runtime reachability). Reason is checked for presence only; no reason-content quality check is part of this validator.
Failure evidence fields: interlocking_id, exposed, actions, reason, field_path.

additions.text: exposed:false with an empty or placeholder reason that only fills the field.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming guard required by the author brief: the template is required_field_presence, which a placeholder satisfies trivially. This is planner guidance only. It adds no verifier check; verifier_detail[2] states that reason is checked for presence only.

additions.text: Reason is checked for presence only; no reason-content quality check is part of this validator.
additions.justification: Clarifies that the template required_field_presence (S013) means presence only, so verifiers do not add subjective reason validation. This restates the template; it adds no obligation.

trace.note: 'Every interlocking' means universal scope, so activation covers unchanged declarations.
'planner validates shape only' is a limit on this check's scope (avoid[3], doesNotFire). It does not prohibit separate runtime validation work.
Kept verbatim as 'strict'. No policy expansion.
